claims.gist: By 2027 a large share will create formal AI governance
Regulation, board scrutiny and generative AI spread drive the shift
Many organizations rely on informal AI guidance
Informal governance will break down as AI enters core processes
AI governance is becoming an operating function
Successful organizations will use governance to move faster
They will assign accountability and measure controls
Start with AI inventory, accountable executive and core policies
Scale governance to risk profile and review regularly

thesis: By 2027 most large enterprises will formalize AI governance as an operating function driven by regulation and AI spread.
